description: This file defines internal data structures, constants, and function prototypes for jemalloc's profiling subsystem, including backtrace handling, profiling counters, context management, and thread-specific data.

methods.name: bt_init
methods.description: Initialize a backtrace object with a given vector.

methods.name: prof_backtrace
methods.description: Capture a backtrace, ignoring a specified number of frames.

methods.name: prof_lookup
methods.description: Lookup or create a profiling thread counter based on a backtrace.

methods.name: prof_tdata_get
methods.description: Retrieve or create thread-specific profiling data.

methods.name: prof_sample_threshold_update
methods.description: Update the sampling threshold for profiling based on a pseudo-random process.

methods.name: prof_ctx_get
methods.description: Get profiling context for a given pointer.

methods.name: prof_ctx_set
methods.description: Set profiling context for a given pointer.

methods.name: prof_sample_accum_update
methods.description: Update sampling accumulation and determine if a sample should be taken.

methods.name: prof_malloc
methods.description: Update profiling counters upon memory allocation.

methods.name: prof_realloc
methods.description: Update profiling counters upon memory reallocation.

methods.name: prof_free
methods.description: Update profiling counters upon memory deallocation.
